source.target_rule: flow_grpo ocr.py:32: the first double-quoted span of the prompt

split.generator: numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([0x5d35a5, split_seed])).permutation over the test prompts that do not occur in train.txt (area 5's permutation); the items are every candidate with a short target, in permutation order (not sorted). Training shard: the unique train.txt prompts (first occurrence, file order) with a short target, without any item prompt and without any prompt whose target (spaces removed, lower case) equals an item's target
split.order: items: permutation order (a prefix is a random sample); shard: train.txt file order
split.short_rule: short target: the target has at most 2 whitespace-separated words (len(target.split()) <= 2)
